messages:
sara: Heads-up — started staged rollout for model v3.2-int4 at 5% (1%->5% step). Quick look shows quality lift on our doc benchmark but latency tail creep on long-context slices. Holding here until we agree gating tweaks.

canary-bot: smoke report for thread 4920001111: `{"error_rate":0.0005, "p50":120, "p95":280, "p99":610, "kl_drift":0.032}`. No hard alerts yet but p99 > 600ms.

mike: Got it. p99>600 is concerning for long docs. Can you paste A/B slice numbers?

chen: A/B quick summary (v3.2 vs v3.1): overall quality +1.9% (coarse), long-doc MRR -3.2% on top-decile, hallucination rate +0.4% (mostly in code blocks), latency p99 +~120ms on >2k token requests. Sample sizes: ~12k evals, 95% conf intervals tight on overall but wider on long-doc slice.

jordan: Proposal: enable a "safety-curtain" gating layer for this rollout. Rules: (a) block promotion if p99 > 600-650ms on any critical slice, (b) block if any monitored slice has quality delta < 0, (c) block if KL drift > 0.05. Automatic fallback: immediate route to stable when error_rate > 0.5% over 15m OR p99 > 800ms sustained for 5m.

mike: Implementation notes — prefer softer step-up: allow next traffic step if p99 < 650ms AND long-doc delta > -1%. Rollback if p99 > 700ms for 10m. Add rolling z-score to avoid reacting to single noisy windows.

sara: Agree on hybrid. For now we hold at 5% and apply safety-curtain thresholds: `{"hold_p99":650, "rollback_p99":800, "err_rollback":0.005, "slice_min_delta":-0.015}`. I'll open a promotion PR and mark it WIP until metrics stabilize.

canary-bot: applied routing policy patch: `safety-curtain: enabled` on v3.2 @5%. Monitoring windows configured: short=5m, medium=15m, alert channels set to #eng-ml and oncall.

chen: I'll re-run long-doc evals with 10 different seeds and increase shadow traffic slice to 20% for targeted samples. Expect updated numbers by EOD.

mike: Ops question — can we add a partial fallback knob that reroutes 30% back to v3.1 when p99 enters [650,800] to bleed off tail without full rollback? config example: `{"partial_fallback_step":0.3, "target":"v3.1"}`

jordan: Yes — do partial fallback + min_window=5m to avoid oscillation. Also log a debug trace of affected requests so we can correlate prompt shapes with latency.

sara: Sounds good. Thanks team — hold promotion PR open, I'll pause any automatic step-ups until chen's re-eval finishes. Ping me on alerts or if canary-bot trips. :pray:
